scope: Offline evidence probes only. No flights, route modification, label changes, or external evidence writes.
phase_probe_selection: First saved nominal_revisit_geometry_infeasible candidate of the first monitoring skeleton in each family, in sorted skeleton order. No selection by optimizer outcome.
phase_probe_limit: Passing the unchanged nominal phase screen proves only phase-screen feasibility at this saved radius; it does not establish route or actual episode success.
solo_probe_limit: Time-shifted solo positions approximate joint execution; shared engine event boundaries can cause residual differences. Actual joint audit remains authoritative.

solo_alignment.prediction_grid_basis: 10 Hz from zero to max(solo end + departure delay); independent of joint trajectory and labels
